Omitting the filter or specifying a filter of `customer=="customers/my_customer"` will return the profiles for the customer that the caller (authenticated user) belongs to. Specifying a filter of `customer==""` will return the global shared OIDC profiles.

pageToken.description: A page token, received from a previous `ListInboundOidcSsoProfiles` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters provided to `ListInboundOidcSsoProfiles` must match the call that provided the page token.
